Sightline's 15.2GW cohort was not obtained. Epoch's Stargate totals include future phases, and Anthropic's deals are stated as 'up to' amounts with no matching construction sites.
CBRE's tight-vacancy data and Nvidia's 10-K risk language show general constraints, but no matched comparison of GPU sales and feasible installations exists.
Gamma's own release claims $100M ARR and profitability, a possible counterexample. But it is self-reported ARR with undefined profit, and the sweeping claim reads as rhetorical.
GitHub ties the restrictions to rising compute demand, which fits the claim. But no independent source confirms the near-doubling of weekly costs; reports repeating it trace back to Zitron.
This is a broad, hedged opinion. One RCT found a developer slowdown and retail field experiments found productivity gains; there is no industry-wide profit or customer-return measure.
